title: Suno Major Update! Advanced Track Separation and Car Support Added
excerpt: Recently, the AI music generation platform Suno announced a series of major updates, covering both web and mobile versions, significantly improving user creatio
content_html:
Recently, the AI music generation platform Suno announced a series of major updates, covering both web and mobile versions, significantly improving user creation efficiency and overall experience. From professional audio processing to car scene compatibility, Suno is accelerating the AI music creation into a more practical and convenient new stage.

Advanced Stem Separation Technology

One of the biggest highlights in the update is Advanced Stem Separation. This feature can accurately separate a song into individual tracks such as vocals, drums, bass, and instruments, helping musicians quickly obtain high-quality materials for secondary creation or remixing, greatly reducing the threshold for post-production.

Export Stems as MIDI Format

Following this is the Export Stems as MIDI feature. Users can now directly export the separated stems as MIDI files, which is highly valuable for professional users who need further fine-tuning in DAWs (Digital Audio Workstations), truly achieving seamless integration between AI-generated content and traditional music production workflows.

Lyric Co-Writer & Autosave

In terms of creative experience, Suno has added Lyric Co-Writer & Autosave. The AI can assist users in refining lyrics while automatically saving progress, eliminating the worry of losing content due to interrupted creation, significantly enhancing the smoothness of long-term creation.

Screenshot to Song

The most creative update is Screenshot to Song. Users just need to upload an image, and Suno will generate a matching musical piece based on it. This feature further lowers the barrier to music creation, allowing visual inspiration to be instantly transformed into audio creativity, especially suitable for content creators and short video producers.

Comprehensive Support for Car Systems

To meet users' needs for music anytime, anywhere, Suno has also officially launched support for Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Users can directly control Suno to generate or play music through the car system while driving, making AI music truly integrated into daily life scenarios.

AIbase Review: This concentrated update by Suno demonstrates its evolution from a pure generation tool to a full-cycle music creation platform. Whether professional musicians or casual enthusiasts, everyone can find tools to improve efficiency or spark inspiration.

content_html_zh:
近日，AI音乐生成平台Suno宣布了一系列重大更新，涵盖网页版和移动版，显着提升用户创作效率和整体体验。 从专业音频处理到车载场景兼容，尚诺正在加速AI音乐创作进入更加实用、便捷的新阶段。

先进的茎分离技术

此次更新的最大亮点之一是高级茎分离。 该功能可以将歌曲精准分离为人声、鼓、贝斯、乐器等单独的音轨，帮助音乐人快速获取高质量素材进行二次创作或混音，大大降低后期制作门槛。

将 Stem 导出为 MIDI 格式

接下来是导出 Stems 作为 MIDI 功能。 用户现在可以直接将分离的主干导出为 MIDI 文件，这对于需要在 DAW（数字音频工作站）中进一步微调的专业用户来说非常有价值，真正实现 AI 生成内容与传统音乐制作工作流程之间的无缝集成。

歌词共同作者和自动保存

在创作体验上，Suno新增了Lyric Co-Writer & Autosave。 AI可以协助用户精炼歌词，同时自动保存进度，消除因创作中断而丢失内容的担忧，大幅提升长期创作的流畅度。

截图为歌曲

最有创意的更新是截图转歌。 用户只需上传一张图片，Suno就会根据它生成匹配的音乐作品。 这一功能进一步降低了音乐创作的门槛，让视觉灵感瞬间转化为音频创意，特别适合内容创作者和短视频制作者。

对汽车系统的全面支持

为了满足用户随时随地的音乐需求，Suno还正式推出了对Apple CarPlay和Android Auto的支持。 用户在驾驶时可以通过车载系统直接控制Suno生成或播放音乐，让AI音乐真正融入日常生活场景。

AIbase评测：Suno的这次集中更新展示了其从纯粹的生成工具到全周期音乐创作平台的演变。 无论是专业音乐家还是休闲爱好者，每个人都可以找到提高效率或激发灵感的工具。
